_provenance.supersedes: The thirteen risks R01-R13 of the Master Draft configuration (fieldwise-run-01). The Pack's risk table carries ten rows, restated below in table order.
_provenance.field_mapping: title and mitigation are the Pack risk table's Risk and Mitigation columns, verbatim in substance. The table's single L/I column is split into likelihood and impact (L = low, M = medium, H = high). The Pack assigns no risk categories, owners or affected work packages; Phase 6 populates the full risk register.

risks.title: Historical MATE variables differ among years
risks.mitigation: Use an explicit year-by-variable matrix; harmonise only defensible common variables; retain year-specific measurements as secondary information.

risks.title: Effective biological sample size is limited
risks.mitigation: Use repeated-measure/hierarchical structure, conservative feature reduction and parsimonious modelling; no deep-learning dependency.

risks.title: Farmer site lacks modern monitoring infrastructure
risks.mitigation: Install project meteorological station and soil sensors before the validation campaign; define maintenance and data-quality responsibilities.

risks.title: Primary farmer access changes or is interrupted
risks.mitigation: Secure written access; maintain the Szentendre Skanzen model-garden route as a contingency subject to formal agreement and scientific suitability.

risks.title: ELTE instrument access or timing is constrained
risks.mitigation: Use a written equipment/operation schedule; prioritise key physiological dates; retain physiology/proximal sensing as the core pathway if individual UAV campaigns are missed.

risks.title: Field geometry or clouds limit Sentinel-2 interpretation
risks.mitigation: Use Sentinel only where valid pixels support field-scale inference; rely on UAV/proximal observations for finer spatial scales.

risks.title: Prospective performance drops
risks.mitigation: Treat transfer loss as a scientific result; quantify uncertainty and use limited transparent recalibration rather than hiding the gap.

risks.title: Krumatic web development is delayed
risks.mitigation: Develop incrementally from the existing desktop prototype; scientific deliverables remain primary; prioritise validated core functions over feature breadth.

risks.title: AgroVIR cannot provide proprietary/customer data
risks.mitigation: Design placement around usability/interoperability requirements and protected/coded extracts; unrestricted customer-system access is not a project dependency.

risks.title: MATE-derived assets have commercial restrictions
risks.mitigation: Use for approved research; maintain background/foreground inventory and conduct institutional data-rights/IP assessment before commercial exploitation.

risk_philosophy.statement: Transfer loss is treated as a scientific result: performance decrease under prospective validation is quantified, its uncertainty stated, and limited transparent recalibration applied rather than hiding the gap.
risk_philosophy.source_ref: Pack §3.1 risk table row 7; Pack §1.1.7 H2
